processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-rdc.plain_language_name: Frame How the Enterprise Will Be Capitalized
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-rdc.plain_language_description: With the model verified, the processing custodian does the framing itself: where the money comes from, how it is structured, and what posture the enterprise holds are worked out within the bounded monetary model, set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-rdc.business_purpose: It exists because a monetary model without a capital answer is a ledger with no income - the framing is where the enterprise decides how it will be paid for.
processes:task-fa-conceive-transform-rdc.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified model is ready to be framed within, and it ends with the framed capital posture produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in the strategy function frames the sources, structure, and posture for the enterprise's capital within the bounded model, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-mrfsye.plain_language_name: Check the Model Before Framing the Capital Posture
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-mrfsye.plain_language_description: Before anything is framed, the verification custodian checks the bounded monetary model against what framing requires - that its bounds are stated completely enough to frame a capital posture within. Defects are flagged for rejection or repair before the framing is made.
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-mrfsye.business_purpose: It exists so the capital posture is never framed inside a model that was only partly bounded.
processes:task-fa-conceive-verify-mrfsye.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the model can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds the model's bounds unstated for one currency posture and flags the defect before the capital posture is framed.

processes:task-fa-conceive-record-dna7zg.plain_language_name: File the Monetary Model Audit Record
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-dna7zg.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the framing trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. What the model bounded - currencies, conventions, recognition - stays readable whenever the enterprise's money story is examined.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-dna7zg.business_purpose: It exists so the money model behind every figure can be evidenced whenever it is questioned.
processes:task-fa-conceive-record-dna7zg.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the model trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles a strategy review would consult.

processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-es2pg.plain_language_description: When the model stands bounded, the confirmation custodian reconciles it against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-es2pg.business_purpose: It exists so the capital posture is framed only within a model confirmed as bounded.
processes:task-fa-conceive-confirm-es2pg.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the bounded model awaits its consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers informed, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the bounded model against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the capital framing needs.
